questions.question: Explain two religious teachings about the purpose of the family.
questions.correctAnswer: 1) Christianity teaches the family is the "domestic church" — the first place children learn about God. Parents have a duty to raise children in faith through baptism, prayer and worship. 2) Islam teaches that the family is the foundation of the ummah.
